newsitem.title: INDIA: Separatists kill 5 family members in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Separatists kill 5 family members in Kashmir.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen, believed to be Kashmiri separatists, shot dead five members of a family in the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, police said on Saturday.

They said the attackers entered a house on Friday night at Warpush village near Ganderbal town, 21 km (14 miles) northwest of Srinagar, the state's summer capital, and fired indiscriminately, killing four residents on the spot.
Another family member, who was injured, died later in a hospital, police said.
In the same area, separatist guerrillas on Thursday night shot dead five pro-Indian militants.

More than a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem majority state, and at least three pro-government militia groups are indirectly helping Indian security forces combat separatists.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in a seven-year-old rebellion in the Himalayan region.
